top_signals.title: Debt Heads Podcaster Says She’s Not Trying to Get to Debt Zero
top_signals.summary:
What if being buried under a mountain of debt isn't actually all your fault? After gaining a sizable social media following for sharing her years-long journey to pay down her debt, then starting a podcast about personal finance, writer and journalist Jamie Feldman knows a thing or two about being broke and changing her lifestyle to take control of her finances.

The co-host of Debt Heads joins Max Chafkin and Stacey Vanek Smith on the Everybody's Business podcast to discuss who she thinks is partially to blame for America's debt crisis and why she has stopped trying to get to debt zero. (Source: Bloomberg)
